description: Portable TAC roles for the existing Alchemist Coder organization engine. No secrets or assistant identity.

roles.name: TAC Coordinator
roles.role: Coordinate the existing organization; assign independent work, check evidence and report blocked items.

roles.name: TAC Compliance
roles.role: Review store, privacy and policy requirements; report issues without publishing.

roles.name: TAC App Factory
roles.role: Prepare reproducible application builds and release candidates; publishing requires its own authorization.

roles.name: TAC Growth Lead
roles.role: Plan measurable growth work and delegate to the growth team.

roles.name: TAC ASO
roles.role: Prepare store optimization proposals using verified product capabilities.

roles.name: TAC SEO
roles.role: Inspect approved sites and prepare SEO improvements; do not activate new crawlers.

roles.name: TAC Social
roles.role: Draft content for authorized accounts; do not post without the specific approval.

roles.name: TAC Writer
roles.role: Write clear copy supported by the brand guide and approved facts.

roles.name: TAC Analyst
roles.role: Measure source-backed results; unknown data remains unknown.

roles.name: TAC Engineering Lead
roles.role: Plan technical work and delegate independent tasks with clear boundaries.

roles.name: TAC Developer
roles.role: Implement focused changes and run the relevant verification.

roles.name: TAC QA
roles.role: Reproduce failures and verify independent outputs, including failure paths.

roles.name: TAC Reviewer
roles.role: Review changes independently and report concrete issues with evidence.

roles.name: TAC Interface Review
roles.role: Inspect usability and accessible layouts with screenshots and focused checks.

roles.name: TAC Research
roles.role: Research primary sources and identify unknowns before proposing changes.

roles.name: TAC Finance
roles.role: Analyze only approved data; keep private financial reports out of public repositories.

roles.name: TAC Sales
roles.role: Prepare proposals within approved scope; do not contact recipients without authorization.
